messages:
zoe: thinking we need a formal "seed rotation" flow for flags. recent reshuffle incident shows cache churn + billing surprises. want preview -> dry-run -> staged apply -> rollback.

matt: yup. API should version seed + hash_version. preview endpoint returns pct_changed_by_geo and a small sample.

hana: UX: console must surface estimated token delta and a sample of affected user ids (cap 10k). include 'I understand reshuffle' checkbox when committing.

matt: infra notes: staged steps (preview -> 1% -> 10% -> 100%) with cache warmup job between steps. auto-pause if redis miss-rate or p99 spikes.

ops-bot: incident reminder: PLTF-311 seed rotate caused 12% redis miss-rate spike for 30m.

zoe: gating rules proposal: block rotation if >5% churn in last 7d; require dry_run=24h and exposure metric within tolerance before first step.

matt: tests: deterministic mapping unit tests, sim for distribution, and stress test for cache churn. include hash_version migration plan.

hana: console: show annotation when seed or hash_version changes; persist seed in ledger for analytics joins.

zoe: decision: allow manual seed but require 2-step confirm + audit log; default to auto:<deploy_id>:ts. i'll write the RFC and link tasks.

ops-bot: task created PLTF-599 seed-rotation-preview-api (assignee: hana).

zoe: thanks all, will follow up with PR and mockups. :thumbsup:
